instruction: I need to set my default text editor to vim for command-line operations. Could you configure the EDITOR environment variable in my shell configuration so that vim is used by default?

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)
